#   copied  2026-09-04 by CL1/DiskM2WF
#
# WHY THESE POINTS ARE REUSABLE VERBATIM.  BinM2Ev is the same strategy space
# (2^16 binary memory-2), the same parametrisation (R,S,T,P) = (1, u, 1+v, 0)
# and the same disk map phi(u,v) = (u,v)/sqrt(k^2+u^2+v^2) at k = 4.  Only the
# PROCESS PARAMETERS differ, and that is the point of running them here:
#   BinM2Ev ca6   N =  100, mu = 1e-4, eps -> 0 limit payoffs, 20 replicates
#   DiskM2WF vor  N = 1000, u  = 1e-2, eps = 1e-4,             10 replicates
# so the two campaigns are the SAME 512 GAMES in opposite regimes and their
# Voronoi maps overlay cell for cell.
#
# Columns 6-10 below (n beta mu itend nrep) are ca6's parameters and are NOT
# ours; only columns 1-3 (ipt u v) are read by Opt/mkgames.py.  Every
# coordinate is a multiple of 2^-10, exact as a decimal and as a double, and
# already nudged clear of all 280 lines of the exact Nash arrangement.
